senses.gloss:
Saindhava, ‘coming from the Indus,’ is a term applied to water in the taittirīya Saṃhitā, to guggulu in the Atharvaveda, to a horse in the Śatapatha, brāhmaṇa, and to salt in the same text.

xi. 5, 5, 12; Bṛhadāraṇyaka upaniṣad, vi. 2, 13 (Mādhyaṃdina = vi. 1, 13 kāṇva).
